state.description: Certificate DN: State or Province (ST). Leave empty to omit.

locality.description: Certificate DN: Locality (L). Leave empty to omit.

organizational_unit.description: Certificate DN: Organizational Unit (OU). Leave empty to omit.

email.description: Certificate DN: Email Address. Leave empty to omit.

hostname.description: The valid hostname of the certificate. Must be an FQDN.

subject_alt_names.description: Optional additional valid hostnames/IPs for the certificate. Items are strings.

key_strength.description: Strength of the certificate private keys in bits.

hash_alg.description: Hashing algorithm to use for signing.

cipher_alg.description: Cipher to use for encrypting key files.

ca_file.description: Path where the public CA certificate will be stored.

ca_mode.description: File mode of the created CA certificate (e.g., 0644). Leave empty for default.

ca_key_file.description: Path where the CA's private key will be stored. Leave empty to destroy key after creation.

ca_key_mode.description: File mode of the created CA key. Leave empty for default.

ca_key_password.description: Password for CA key file. Visible in process table; use passfile or prompt for production.

ca_key_passfile.description: File containing password to encrypt CA key file.

ca_key_password_prompt.description: Prompt to enter a password for the CA key file.

crl_file.description: Path where an empty Certificate Revocation List file will be created. Leave empty to omit.

crl_mode.description: File mode of the created Certificate Revocation List. Leave empty for default.

cert_file.description: Path where the public service certificate will be stored.

cert_mode.description: File mode of the created certificate. Leave empty for default.

cert_key_file.description: Path where the service's private key will be stored.

cert_key_mode.description: File mode of the certificate key. Leave empty for default.

cert_key_password.description: Password for service key file. Visible in process table; use passfile or prompt for production.

cert_key_passfile.description: File containing password to encrypt service key file.

cert_key_password_prompt.description: Prompt to enter a password for the service key file.

client_file.description: Path where a client authentication certificate will be stored. Leave empty to omit client cert.

client_mode.description: File mode of the client certificate. Leave empty for default.

client_key_file.description: Path where the client's private key will be stored. Leave empty to use client-file path.

client_key_mode.description: File mode of the client key. Leave empty for default.

client_key_password.description: Password for client key file. Visible in process table; use passfile or prompt for production.

client_key_passfile.description: File containing password to encrypt client key file.

client_key_password_prompt.description: Prompt to enter a password for the client key file.

dhparams_file.description: A file to contain a set of Diffie-Hellman parameters. Leave empty to omit.

dhparams_named_group.description: Output well-known DH parameters. E.g., ffdhe2048, ffdhe3072.

dhparams_prime_len.description: Length of prime number to generate for dhparams in bits. 0 to use named group.

dhparams_generator.description: Generator value for dhparams. 0 to use default (2).

quiet.description: Display no output unless there is an error.

force.description: Overwrite any pre-existing files in the requested locations.
